# grxblasGemmEx on the photonic tile: golden results.
#
# Emitted by tests/libs/test_grxblas_pta --regenerate from
# third_party/grx930/pta_tile_model.c. tests/libs/test_grxblas_pta holds
# grxblasGemmEx on the tile to every number below, bit for bit.
#
# GOLDEN DATA. Do not edit by hand. A number here moves only when the
# vendored error model moves, and then this file is regenerated and its
# diff goes in the same change, so the move is seen (AGENTS.md section 4).
#
# Operands are int8, from the model's xorshift32 seeded with
# op_seed ^ 0x2545f491: A first (m*k values, column-major), then B
# (k*n), each the low byte of the state. The tile is reset to the
# case's seed before its first GEMM. C is column-major, m*n int32.
# A is the weight set; each column of B is one shot.

tile rows=4 cols=4 operand_bits=16 accumulator_bits=48
